42:     try:
43:         with zipfile.ZipFile(local_zip_fname, "r") as f:
44:             f.extractall(path=target_dir)
45:         if verbose:
46:             print("Successfully extracted file %s to path %s" %
47:                   (local_zip_fname, target_dir))
48:         return target_dir
49:     except zipfile.BadZipFile:
50:         warnings.warn("Corrupted or missing zip file encountered, aborting",
51:                       category=RuntimeWarning)
52:         return None
53:     finally:
54:         shutil.rmtree(tmpdir, ignore_errors=True)
55: 
56: 
57: def in_file_string_replace(filename, old_string, new_string):
58:     """String replacement within a text file. It is used to fix typos in
59:     downloaded csv file.
60: 
61:     The code was modified from "https://stackoverflow.com/questions/4128144/"
62: 
63:     Parameters
64:     ----------
65:     filename : str
66:         Path to the file where strings should be replaced
67:     old_string : str
68:         The string to be replaced in the file.
69:     new_string : str
70:         The new string that will replace old_string
71:     """
72:     with open(filename) as f:
73:         s = f.read()
74: 
75:     with open(filename, 'w') as f:
76:         s = s.replace(old_string, new_string)
77:         f.write(s)
